name: Rust Deer Plant
subtitle: Wild Game Processing
intro: Wild game processing shop in Cisco, Texas. Since 2021, we've treated every hunter's harvest with the same care we give our own. We specialize in smoked meats and offer European mounts. Proudly family-owned and local, we're made for those who like it wild!
plantHistory: The plant has served Cisco and the Big Country for over 35 years. Dustin and Leta Ferguson have run it as a family business since 2021.

address.note: About four miles east of downtown Cisco on Highway 6. The meat plant next door at 8911 Highway 6 is a different business.

faq.a: Basic processing on any animal includes back straps (whole or steaks), tenderloin (whole or steaks), hind quarters (whole, roast or steaks), plus burger and chili. Cut options like tenderizing, round steaks and specialty sausage are added on your cut ticket.
During the season (October through January) we're open 9 AM to 9 PM, seven days a week. We close on Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Eve and Christmas Day, but the back-deck drop-off stays open.

faq.q: Can I drop off after hours?
faq.a: Yes. Use the drop-off on the back deck: tag your animal with your name and phone number, and we'll call you the next business day for your cut ticket. Animals left after hours with the guts in are charged an extra $100.

faq.q: What do I pay at drop-off?
faq.a: Your basic processing fee (the amount depends on the animal), plus a cape fee ($45, or $60 for a large cape) and the $75 field dress fee if they apply. Excessively dirty animals require a $25 clean-up fee. The rest is due at pick-up. We take cash (preferred), cards and checks.

faq.q: How long do I have to pick up?
faq.a: You have 14 days from the day we call or text that your order is ready. After that, freezer rent is $5.00 a day. Anything left after the last pickup date of the season is donated.

You're responsible for contacting your taxidermist to arrange pickup of your cape. We hold capes for your taxidermist for 7 days. After that, a $10 daily freezer fee applies, and all freezer fees must be paid before the cape is released.

faq.q: Is there a minimum on sausage?
faq.a: Yes. There's a 6 lb minimum on all sausage.

faq.q: Do you offer a military discount?
faq.a: Yes. Military and first responders get 20% off Basic Processing.

faq.q: Do you take hogs and exotics?
faq.a: Yes, all season long. We process hogs, elk, axis, fallow, red stag, aoudad, oryx, kudu, eland, bison and more. See the Exotics page for prices.

faq.q: Do you take animals hunted outside Texas?
faq.a: Yes. Hunters bring us game from New Mexico, Arizona and other states. Bring the license and tags from the state you hunted in, and check the carcass transport rules before you cross state lines.

reviews.name: Wesley D.
reviews.text: Been taking deer here for several years now and always turn out a great product. Can't say enough! Love the sausage combos they have to choose from. That chipotle jack is where it's at!

reviews.name: Cristen C.
reviews.text: Rust Deer Plant has ONLY the best people!! You can see the excitement on their face when you pull up with something in the back of the truck to be processed! Everyone there makes you feel like family, they're kind-hearted and they genuinely care about their customers!

reviews.name: Ashton D.
reviews.text: One of the cleanest nicest places to have an animal processed! Everything was nicely packaged and boxed for pick up! Delicious, very happy with services!

reviews.name: Dustin C.
reviews.text: Rust Deer Plant is one of the best in the business. We've taken 6 deer and a hog and will be back this 25/26 hunting season.

reviews.name: Jason J.
reviews.text: Great staff, hard working people that love the sport of hunting as well as makin' sure your order is done the way you like.

reviews.name: Travis R.
reviews.text: Fast, quality and friendly. All great reasons to use Rust.

reviews.name: Bella L.
reviews.text: Great family and great service. We get our meat back super fast. Thank you all for what you do.

reviews.name: Stephen A.
reviews.text: Good people, good service, good quality. Can't beat that!!! Rust Deer Plant is the Best.

reviews.name: Adams B.
reviews.text: Great place and down home friendly folks.
